verdict.rationale: The docs show self-hosting from the public GitHub repository: you `git clone` it and run `./start.sh`. They also state you can run Airweave yourself on macOS, Linux or WSL, with a local dashboard at localhost:8080. A competitor founder's launch comment describes it as part of the open-source AI space, which supports the open-source claim. missing for 10: explicit Docker/Compose or Kubernetes deployment docs, guidance for production or remote-server deployment beyond local machines, a stated open-source license, independent hands-on self-host reports.
